section_summary.extract_value: This introduction describes limitations of existing measures of breast size dissatisfaction and summarizes the development and validation of the 14-image Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS) in prior British samples (four studies). The authors state that the present study examines the psychometric properties and 15-day test-retest reliability of the BSRS in a sample of Brazilian women (single study; referred to here as the present study).
section_summary.evidence_source: To overcome these limitations, Swami et al. (2015) developed the Breast Size Rating Scale (BSRS), a figural rating scale consisting of 14 computer-generated images... Across four studies with British women, these authors provided evidence for the measure's construct validity, test-retest reliability... In the present study, therefore, we sought to examine the psychometric properties of the BSRS in a sample of Brazilian women. ... We also assessed test-retest reliability of BSRS-derived scores after 15 days.
